intro.title: Your Privacy Matters
paragraphs: Welcome to JustFlip. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information entrusted to us.
This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, how we use and protect it, when we may share it, and the choices available to you when using the JustFlip platform.

By accessing or using JustFlip, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the practices described in this policy, please discontinue use of the platform.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect information that you provide directly to us, information generated when you use our services, and information received from certain third-party sources.

subsections.title: Information You Provide
items: Your name, email address, phone number, and other contact information.
Account credentials and profile information.
Property preferences, saved properties, searches, and enquiries.
Property listing information submitted by owners, agents, brokers, developers, or other users.
Information you provide when communicating with our support team.
Any other information you voluntarily provide while using our services.

subsections.title: Information Collected Automatically
items: IP address and approximate location information.
Browser type, operating system, device type, and language preferences.
Pages visited, searches performed, listings viewed, and interactions with the platform.
Information about how you access and use our website and services.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect for legitimate business and service-related purposes, including providing, maintaining, securing, and improving the JustFlip platform.
items: To create and manage your account.
To provide property searches, recommendations, and relevant listings.
To process and respond to property enquiries.
To connect users with property owners, agents, brokers, developers, or other relevant parties where requested.
To communicate important account, service, property, and platform updates.
To provide customer support and respond to your questions.
To improve the performance, functionality, and user experience of our platform.
To detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, abuse, security threats, and unauthorized activity.
To comply with applicable laws, regulations, legal processes, or governmental requests.

sections.title: Property Listings and Enquiries
paragraphs: JustFlip allows users and property professionals to publish listings and submit enquiries relating to properties. Information associated with a property listing may be visible to other users of the platform.
When you submit an enquiry or request to contact a property owner, agent, broker, developer, or other party, information necessary to respond to that request may be shared with the relevant party.
items: Property listing details may include location, pricing, photographs, descriptions, amenities, and other property-related information.
Information submitted through an enquiry may include your name, phone number, email address, message, and other information you choose to provide.
You should avoid including unnecessary sensitive personal information in property enquiries or public listing content.

sections.title: How We Share Your Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information as part of our ordinary business practices. We may share information when reasonably necessary to provide our services, operate our platform, protect our users, or comply with legal obligations.

subsections.title: Service Providers
paragraphs: We may share relevant information with trusted third-party service providers that support functions such as hosting, infrastructure, analytics, communications, security, payment processing, and other technical services.

subsections.title: Property-Related Parties
paragraphs: When you request information about a property or submit an enquiry, information necessary to respond to your request may be shared with the relevant property owner, agent, broker, developer, or other authorized party.

subsections.title: Legal and Security Requirements
paragraphs: We may disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with applicable laws, respond to lawful requests, enforce our agreements, investigate suspected fraud, protect our rights, or protect the safety and security of our users and platform.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: JustFlip may use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, maintain user sessions, understand usage patterns, improve website performance, and support platform functionality.
Some cookies may be provided by third-party services that operate on or integrate with our platform.
items: Essential cookies may be required for certain platform functionality.
Preference cookies may help remember settings and choices.
Analytics technologies may help us understand how users interact with the platform.
You may be able to control or disable certain cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

However, no method of transmission over the internet or method of electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. You should also take reasonable precautions to protect your account credentials and devices.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, including providing services, maintaining business records, resolving disputes, preventing fraud, enforcing agreements, and complying with legal obligations.
When information is no longer required for these purposes, we may delete, anonymize, or otherwise dispose of it in accordance with applicable requirements and our operational practices.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law and your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.
items: Request access to personal information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
Request deletion of certain personal information where legally permitted.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Request information about how your personal information is processed.
Opt out of certain marketing communications.
sections.footerParagraph: To make a privacy-related request, please contact us using the contact information provided below. We may need to verify your identity before processing certain requests.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: JustFlip is not intended for children who are under the minimum age required to use our services under applicable law.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable legal requirements. If you believe that a child has provided personal information to us improperly, please contact us so that we can take appropriate action.

sections.title: Third-Party Services and Links
paragraphs: The JustFlip platform may contain links to third-party websites, services, maps, payment providers, analytics platforms, or other external services.

These third parties may have their own privacy policies and terms of use. JustFlip is not responsible for the privacy practices, security, or content of independent third-party services that are outside our control.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies of third-party services before providing them with personal information.

sections.title: Account Security and User Responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for activities performed through your account.
You should use appropriate security practices when accessing your JustFlip account and notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access.
items: Keep your username, password, and authentication information confidential.
Do not share your account credentials with unauthorized individuals.
Use a strong and unique password where applicable.
Notify JustFlip if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.
Ensure that information submitted through your account is accurate and lawful.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our services, technology, business practices, or applicable legal requirements.
When changes are made, we will update the Last Updated date displayed at the beginning of this Privacy Policy.
We encourage you to review this page periodically so that you remain informed about how your information is handled.
